claim_contract.semantic_rule: Each factual record is one atomic proposition limited to its exact cited source envelope; source evidence does not establish browser execution, trusted input, or acceptance.

claims.source_fact: The component initializes gameState and results as null, gamePhase as start, and has a one-shot completion-report ref.
claims.interpretation: Source-defined initial component state only; it does not prove a mounted or runnable browser session.

claims.source_fact: resetGame creates a Shadow Gate Dungeon state from vocabulary and selected difficulty and creature, clears results, and clears the reported ref.
claims.interpretation: Reset implementation envelope only; it does not establish that a user invoked resetGame.

claims.source_fact: The configured game dimensions are 390 by 700, with a 100 by 60 exit gate, player speed 200, player radius 12, and initial health 100.
claims.interpretation: Static configuration values only; no viewport measurement is claimed.

claims.source_fact: The configuration defines creature patrol and chase speeds, creature radius 14, sight radius 75, chase duration 1500 ms, patrol radius 70, patrol center 195/350, collision damage 25, wrong-word damage 20, and XP constants.
claims.interpretation: Configuration envelope only; it does not establish observed detection or chase behavior.

claims.source_fact: The component registers keydown and keyup listeners for arrows and WASD, prevents default for recognized keydown inputs, updates pressed keys, and computes a velocity.
claims.interpretation: Keyboard listener source only; it does not prove trusted native input or movement in a browser.

claims.source_fact: handleDPadInput applies a supplied dx/dy velocity through setPlayerVelocity when the game is playing.
claims.interpretation: D-pad adapter source only; it does not establish touch delivery or trusted input.

claims.source_fact: tickShadowGateDungeon advances gameTime and clamps player x and y between the player radius and the configured game bounds while applying velocity and invincibility decay.
claims.interpretation: Deterministic state-update source fact; no runtime movement outcome is claimed.

claims.source_fact: The state update enters chase mode and resets chaseTimer when player distance is below sightRadius, and decrements the timer while chasing otherwise.
claims.interpretation: State-machine envelope only; browser detection is unknown.

claims.source_fact: When not chasing, the creature position is calculated on a circular path around the configured patrol center and radius, with tangential velocity.
claims.interpretation: Source-defined patrol calculation only; it does not prove an observed patrol route.

claims.source_fact: If the player is not invincible and the player-creature distance is below the sum of their radii, the update subtracts creature collision damage and sets invincibility.
claims.interpretation: Collision branch source fact only; no collision was observed.

claims.source_fact: On player overlap with an uncollected crystal, the state compares its word to words[targetIndex]; a correct word is marked collected, appended, and advances targetIndex, while a wrong word damages health and increments wrongAnswers without advancing targetIndex.
claims.interpretation: Source-defined ordered progression and wrong-word handling; it does not prove user completion or learning correctness.

claims.source_fact: After targetIndex reaches the word count, the gate is unlocked; if the player is close enough to the gate center, status becomes victory.
claims.interpretation: Deterministic victory transition envelope only; no browser completion is claimed.

claims.source_fact: The state update returns with status defeat when collision damage reduces player health to zero or below.
claims.interpretation: State transition source fact only; it does not establish a rendered defeat screen.

claims.source_fact: The render scale is the smaller of container width divided by GAME_WIDTH and container height divided by GAME_HEIGHT, or 1 when dimensions are zero.
claims.interpretation: Scale calculation source fact only; compact and wide viewport outcomes remain untested.

claims.source_fact: When gameState status is victory or defeat, the component computes accuracy and XP, sets results, changes gamePhase to ended, and calls onComplete once through hasReportedRef.
claims.interpretation: Component callback logic only; it does not prove callback delivery in a browser or persistence.

claims.source_fact: The page owns sentence state and starts with an empty sentence list and loading state, then fetches the shadow-gate-dungeon sentences endpoint using the current locale.
claims.interpretation: Page source wiring only; no route reachability is claimed.

claims.source_fact: The page completion callback stores XP and accuracy locally and posts xpEarned, accuracy, correctAnswers, and totalAttempts to the shadow-gate-dungeon completion endpoint.
claims.interpretation: Client submission wiring only; API correctness and persistence are not claimed.

claims.source_fact: The sentences route exports GET from createSentencesRoute configured with SAMPLE_SENTENCES and marks the route force-static.
claims.interpretation: Route declaration source fact only; no HTTP execution is claimed.

unknowns_preserved: Browser execution, trusted native input, route reachability, compact/wide behavior, console, network, and runnable disposition remain unknown.
Asset availability, dimensions, loading, and visual suitability remain unknown.
Rooms, collision geometry beyond the cited state logic, camera follow/dead zones, and transition observations remain unknown.
Persistence, XP authority, idempotency, API correctness, and completion success remain unverified.
Provider-side prompt, spawn, ancestry, isolation, event, timing, final-response, and commit attestations are unavailable.
